{{Quote|I am a protocol droid of the series ODX. My primary function is reception and information.|[[ODX-9]]|<ref name="TOR:PA" />}}
The '''ODX-series protocol droid''' was a model of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that was available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Imperial Lieutenant Major [[Pirrell]] used an ODX-series, [[ODX-9]], as his secretary.<ref name="TOR:PA" />
